typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	Fact_Query as string (),
	packageName as string ()
}

source(output(
		IOStatus as string,
		ValidEntryFlag as integer,
		dw_fact_key as integer,
		dw_holder_key as integer,
		dw_gate_Key as integer,
		IODatetime as string,
		Dw_Run_Key as integer,
		Dw_Create_Dt as timestamp,
		Dw_Agg_Key as integer,
		iodate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select fact.dw_fact_key,fact.dw_holder_key,fact.dw_gate_Key,CONVERT( VARCHAR(10),fact.iodate, 120) + \' \' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, fact.iotime, 108)as IODatetime, fact.IOStatus,fact.Dw_Run_Key,fact.Dw_Create_Dt,fact.Dw_Agg_Key,fact.ValidEntryFlag from fact inner join (select max(dw_fact_key)as maxFact,dw_agg_key from fact  		where dw_run_key=102 		group by dw_agg_key) max_fact 		on fact.dw_agg_key =  max_fact.dw_agg_key 		and max_fact.maxFact = fact.dw_fact_key 		and fact.IOStatus = \'Entry\' inner join dim_holder   on fact.dw_holder_key = dim_holder.dw_holder_key',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCFACT	source(output(
		Employeename as string,
		Reason as string,
		ioDate as timestamp,
		ioTime as timestamp,
		ioStatus as string,
		Holderkey as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select O.Employeename,O.Reason,O.ioDate,O.ioTime,O.ioStatus,H.dw_holder_key as Holderkey from dim_holder H inner join  oooioentry O on O.employeename=H.Holder_name  And O.Reason=\'Final Exit\' order by O.ioTime asc',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPOOOIOENTRYLKPTABLE
OLESRCFACT derive(IODatetime = toTimestamp(toString(IODatetime, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion select(mapColumn(
		IODatetime = IODatetime
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DataConversion0
DataConversion0 derive(SRC = toString($packageName)) ~> DRVSRCCol
DRVSRCCol,LKPOOOIOENTRYLKPTABLE lookup(IODatetime == ioTime && iodate == LKPOOOIOENTRYLKPTABLE@ioDate && dw_holder_key == Holderkey,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPOOOIOENTRY
LKPOOOIOENTRY filter(!isMatch()) ~> LKPOOOIOENTRY01
LKPOOOIOENTRY01 select(mapColumn(
		lkp_ioTime = ioTime,
		lkp_Holderkey = Holderkey,
		dw_holder_key = dw_holder_key,
		dw_gate_Key = dw_gate_Key,
		Dw_Agg_Key = Dw_Agg_Key,
		ValidEntryFlag = ValidEntryFlag,
		SRC = SRC,
		IODatetime = IODatetime,
		Dw_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		Dw_Create_Dt = Dw_Create_Dt
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPOOOIOENTRY0
LKPOOOIOENTRY0 sink(input(
		dw_holder_key as integer,
		dw_gate_Key as integer,
		Dw_Agg_Key as integer,
		ValidEntryFlag as integer,
		SRC as string,
		lkp_ioTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		IODatetime as string,
		Dw_Run_Key as integer,
		Dw_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		dw_holder_key = Param_0,
		dw_gate_Key = Param_1,
		Dw_Agg_Key = Param_6,
		ValidEntryFlag = Param_7,
		SRC = Param_8,
		lkp_ioTime = Param_2,
		IODatetime = Param_3,
		Dw_Run_Key = Param_4,
		Dw_Create_Dt = Param_5)) ~> CMDINSERTFACT
